forges.name: Forge Auto-Capture
forges.description: Watches for missing scripts and seeds new ones from repeated gaps.
self_repair_checklist: What did we need that did not exist yet?
What had to be manually inferred?
What should become a script, context asset, test, status, or doctrine rule?

forges.name: Auto-Chunker
forges.description: Detects risky operations and auto-splits into bounded chunks.
self_repair_checklist: What risky patterns are not yet detected?
What bounded patterns are incorrectly flagged as risky?
Does chunk sizing stay within timeout budget?

forges.name: Draft Promotion Runner
forges.description: Promote missing-script drafts immediately into executable, replayed, registered forges.
self_repair_checklist: Was the generated forge replayed from the original user intent?
Did the build trace record changed files, checks, and talkback?
Did intake return a completed response instead of exposing needs_script?
